Terms

Site terms and disclaimer.

Draft for attorney review before launch. Replace this box once it's reviewed.

Information, not treatment

Everything on this site is general information. It isn't therapy or medical advice, and reading it doesn't create a therapist-client relationship. That relationship begins only when we've both agreed to work together and you've signed my consent forms.

Not for emergencies

If you are in crisis or thinking about harming yourself or someone else, call or text 988 or go to your nearest emergency room. Please don't use this site or email to reach me in an emergency.

Who I can serve

I'm licensed in California. I provide therapy only to people who are physically located in California during the session.

Results

I can't promise any particular outcome. Descriptions of methods such as EMDR and the Flash Technique are general and don't guarantee any result.

Testimonials

This site doesn't use client testimonials.

Links

I'm not responsible for the content of third-party sites I link to.
